schema: ledger v1: one entry per experiment; status in {proposed, implemented, running, software-measured, simulated, synthesized, post-route, physically-measured, independently-confirmed, stopped, rejected}

entries.hypothesis: With 256 equal scores, signed 8-bit probabilities round every element to zero.
entries.outcome: Reproduced the 2026-11-11 pilot exactly. 256 tokens: P8 signed code 0 (zero row), P9 signed 1, P10 signed 2, P8 unsigned (qmax 255) 1. At 1024 tokens all are zero.
entries.limitations: Synthetic; says nothing about real data.

entries.hypothesis: The INT8 loss comes from attention-probability precision (flat rows), not from weights or linear activations.
entries.outcome: 10 variants on the canonical validation split (47,580 windows / 195 files; paired file bootstrap). Flat-row hypothesis REJECTED by the frozen gate: 0 all-zero attention rows in every variant (criteria 1 and 2 fail). Mechanism found instead: probability-mass truncation (row mass 0.986 INT10 / 0.829 P8-signed / 0.948 P8-unsigned; nonzero entries per row 185 / 79 / 137; context error 0.074 / 0.225 / 0.115). Macro-F1 change vs INT10 (pp): W8 -0.01 [-0.12,0.14]; A8 -0.62; P8 signed -1.27; P8 unsigned +0.49 [-0.18,1.21]; uniform INT8 -1.82; W8A8+P10 -0.65; W8A8+P8u -0.23 [-1.36,0.38]. P9-signed and P8-unsigned are the same quantizer (qmax 255) and give identical outputs (consistency check). Accuracy gate passed by: W8, P8u(=P9s), W8A8+P8u(=P9s).
entries.limitations: Float-input path (input quantized at the variant's own input scale); a W8A8 hardware variant would also need an 8-bit on-chip preprocessing constant. Validation only; per-class CIs are wide (normal class has 5 validation files).
entries.next_action: Precision finalists for A05: W8A8+P8u (largest expected saving) and/or P8u alone; requires a versioned export, HLS types, own goldens and an integrated build to test the >= 15 % post-route gate.

entries.hypothesis: Some HLS widths exceed proven legal ranges; narrowing them is exact and cheaper.
entries.status: implemented (proof + exhaustive check for the softmax divider)
entries.outcome: Survey of the canonical HLS report: HLS already narrows most requant multipliers (23-24 bit x 32 bit). Candidate not inferred by HLS: attention context requant (df_head_*: mul_33s_33ns_64). Proof sketch: row sum of probability codes <= 511 + 256/2 = 639, |v| <= 511 -> |context accumulator| <= 326,529 < 2^19 (20-bit signed). Second candidate found and taken to A04: the softmax divider (quotient <= 511).
entries.next_action: single-operator HLS + Vivado OOC probe (A04) of the context requant: original vs proven-width

entries.hypothesis: Silent class corruption is concentrated in a few stage groups.
entries.command: python -m tools.research.fault_injection campaign --out artifacts/research/B01_20261113; python -m tools.research.fault_injection weights|vote --out artifacts/research/B01_20261113
entries.outcome: 3,072 transient single-bit flips (8 groups x 3 bit bands x 128) on 256 validation windows (64/class); injection disabled = canonical logits on all 256. Silent class corruptions 75: G8 logits high bits 42, G1 input codes high bits 28, G2 projection accumulator mid bits 4, G3 QKV high 1. Attention scores/probabilities/context: 0 class changes in 3 x 384 injections. Proven-range check C2 flags 100 % of high-band flips in the 32-bit accumulators (G2/G6/G7), incl. all 14 class changes in G2-high; row-sum check C3 flags 65/384 probability flips. Gate (top-2 groups >= 60 % of silent corruptions): PASSED (93 %). Persistent weight-read campaign (384 single-bit flips of one 10-bit weight for a whole window, all 9 layers): logits changed 236, class changed 0. Vote-state campaign (k=5, board clean class stream; 128 history-entry and 128 counter flips): stable decision changed 0 times; 35 history flips changed only the vote count.
entries.limitations: Python INT10 reference with hardware widths; one window per event (no vote state); persistent weight-read and vote-state campaigns not yet run; logical emulation only.
entries.next_action: Protection design focused on the two concentrated points: input-buffer parity (BRAM has spare bits) and a duplicated classifier tail/argmax compare; plus proven-range comparators on accumulators (already 100 % for high-band accumulator flips). Measure silent-corruption reduction on a held-out injection manifest before any B02 build.

entries.hypothesis: Finite-horizon integer evidence lowers decision delay versus k-vote at a matched false-switch budget.
entries.outcome: Validation (selection; budget = vote_5 13.87 false switches/10k): vote_5 acc 99.58 %, p95 2; hyst_3 acc 99.68 %, 4.41 fsw/10k, p95 2; evid_64 acc 99.84 %, 11.77 fsw/10k, p95 1. Frozen gate formally passed (p95 -50 %, F1 not lower, unresolved not increased) but the gain is ONE window and hysteresis has 2.7x fewer false switches: no clear dominance. Board test logits (reported once): evid_64 acc 99.71 % / F1 99.47 % / 12.3 fsw/10k vs vote_5 99.08 % / 98.52 % / 18.3; hyst_3 99.22 % / 3.35 fsw/10k / p95 4. 0 dB stream: all policies 16-18 unresolved transitions. Synthetic 2-window events detected: evid 89 %, vote_5 17 %, hyst_3 10 %.
entries.limitations: Transitions are recording joins (synthetic), integer delay granularity, validation has few transitions; previously explored test.
entries.next_action: Hold FPGA implementation (conditional). If pursued: evid_64 needs 4 x ~9-bit counters + margin (top1-top2) in logic.

entries.hypothesis: Bounded background load (CPU, memory, cache, SD, network) does not break the board-side deadline.
entries.outcome: 7 conditions x 30,000 accepted windows (210,000), 0 deadline misses, all 211,400 outputs = canonical C-model. quiet: misses 0/30000, p50 15.97, p99.9 16.56, max 16.66 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.20, core p99 15.29, start jitter p99 0.014, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 55.5 C | cpu0_busy: misses 0/30000, p50 15.97, p99.9 16.37, max 16.61 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.05, core p99 15.22, start jitter p99 0.013, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 57.5 C | mem_copy: misses 0/30000, p50 16.50, p99.9 16.67, max 16.78 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.37, core p99 15.34, start jitter p99 0.014, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 60.9 C | cache_thrash: misses 0/30000, p50 16.30, p99.9 16.68, max 16.80 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.37, core p99 15.33, start jitter p99 0.014, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 61.3 C | sd_io: misses 0/30000, p50 16.05, p99.9 16.75, max 16.85 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.40, core p99 15.33, start jitter p99 0.013, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 58.9 C | net_rx: misses 0/30000, p50 16.14, p99.9 16.55, max 16.91 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.23, core p99 15.28, start jitter p99 0.014, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 57.5 C | combined: misses 0/30000, p50 16.47, p99.9 16.75, max 16.83 ms, copy+MM2S p99 1.42, core p99 15.36, start jitter p99 0.016, outputs=C-model 30200/30200, Tmax 61.9 C. An UNBOUNDED 1 Gb/s SSH stream dropped the board Ethernet link (known instability at 1 Gb/s); the link was pinned to 100 Mb/s and the network load bounded to 4 MiB/s.
entries.limitations: Finite stress envelope, not a WCET proof; stress pinned to CPU0 where possible; acquisition path not included (RAM windows).
entries.next_action: Mitigation/wrapper not needed (no misses); report the envelope.

entries.hypothesis: The exact divider saves >= 15 % of one post-route resource in the integrated design.
entries.command: powershell -File tools/build_raw_core.ps1 -Variant divq9; python -m tools.raw_core_board_test deploy|golden|fulltest|rt (deployment research_divq9_z7020_20261113)
entries.outcome: HLS C-simulation 41/41 exact against the CANONICAL golden set. Post-route (XC7Z020, 100 MHz): LUT 36,670 -> 30,970 (-15.5 %), FF 36,163 -> 29,394 (-18.7 %), DSP 210 and BRAM 76.5 unchanged, WNS +0.132 ns (canonical +0.167), HLS latency equal (1,502,073 vs 1,502,098 cycles). Gate (>= 15 % of one post-route resource) passed for LUT and FF. Board (2026-11-13, deployment research_divq9_z7020_20261113): golden 41/41 incl. 8 ties; full test 95,404/95,404 logits and class register = canonical C-model, accuracy 97.7705 % (identical to canonical); hard real time 0 misses in 30,000 (p50 15.96 / max 16.63 ms), all 30,200 RAM-window outputs = canonical C-model. Evidence: artifacts/results/raw_core_board_{golden_20261113_144159,fulltest_20261113_144220,rt_20261113_151033}/.
entries.limitations: LUT gain just above the frozen 15 % threshold.
entries.next_action: Exact-arithmetic finalist complete. Optional: combine with a precision finalist (W8A8+P8u) or with the vote core; archive (Z01).

entries.hypothesis: Cheap selective protection (input-buffer parity, duplicated classifier tail, proven-range comparators) removes >= 80 % of silent class corruption.
entries.command: python -m tools.research.fault_injection campaign --seed 20261114 --out artifacts/research/B02_20261113/heldout_campaign; python hls/research/b02_integrity/make_b02_top.py; powershell -File tools/build_raw_core.ps1 -Variant b02
entries.outcome: Protections chosen on the B01 pilot (94.4 % modelled reduction there) and confirmed on a held-out campaign (new seed: new windows and events; injection-off = canonical): silent class corruptions 76 -> 67 (range only), 16 (parity + duplicated tail), 7 (all three) = -90.8 %, above the frozen 80 % gate. Remaining: projection-accumulator mid bits 5, QKV 1, probability 1. Cost under faults: 1,084 flags on faults that did not change the class (availability, not false flags on clean data). Hardware variant B02 v1 (hls/research/b02_integrity/, generated from the canonical raw top): input-buffer XOR signature (write vs after projection read), duplicated cls4 + argmax, projection accumulator range check (bound 719,316 from weights_int10.h); research register integrity_status. Context/FFN range checks left out (0 class changes there in B01). C-model: goldens 41/41 identical + status 0 (incl. edge windows); 95,404 test windows: logits and class identical to canonical, integrity_status 0 on all (0 false flags). Post-route (XC7Z020, 100 MHz): LUT 36,670 -> 37,035 (+1.0 %), FF 36,163 -> 36,606 (+1.2 %), DSP 210 (+0), BRAM 76.5 (+0), WNS +0.202 ns; HLS C-simulation 41/41 exact with integrity_status 0. Overhead gate (<= 5 % LUT, <= 2 DSP, timing) passed.
entries.limitations: Logical model of the protections (single faults, parity covers storage of the input buffer, duplication covers one copy of the tail). Hardware overhead, timing and clean false-flag rate not yet measured.
entries.next_action: HLS: parity bit on the input buffer words, duplicated cls4 + argmax compare, range comparators on proj/ctx/ff0 accumulators, status register (research ABI); build; board: 0 false flags on 95,404 clean windows, outputs = canonical, overhead <= 5 % LUT / <= 2 DSP
